newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario sets C$500 million bond due June, 2027. [CORRECTED 14:33 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Ontario sets C$500 million bond due June, 2027. [CORRECTED 14:33 GMT]

text.p: The Province of Ontario on Monday set C$500 million of 7.6 (corrects figure from 7.5) percent bonds due June 2, 2027 in financial markets, said lead manager CIBC Wood Gundy (corrects name of lead manager from Nesbitt Burns).
The bond was priced at C$106.544 to yield 7.071, 20.5 basis points over the Government of Canada 8.0 percent bond due June, 2023.
The bond will pay interest on December 2 and June 2. The issue will be delivered on June 16.
